questions.text: 'बोनफास्ट सीमेंट लिमिटेड' 7 गाँवों को घरों की सुविधा, विद्यालय, सुरक्षित पेयजल, स्वास्थ्य तथा स्वच्छता में सहयोग करती है । सहायता प्रदान करने तथा यह देखने के लिए कि प्रदान की गई सुविधाएँ धरातल पर कार्यान्वित हो रही हैं अथवा नहीं, कंपनी अपने कर्मचारियों को हर 15 दिनों में पास के एक गाँव में भेजती है । जिस उद्देश्य को 'बोनफास्ट सीमेंट लिमिटेड' प्राप्त करने का प्रयास कर रही है, वह है :
questions.text_english: 'Bonfast Cement Ltd.' supports 7 villages with housing facilities, schools, safe drinking water, health and hygiene. The company sends its employees to visit a nearby village every 15 days to provide support and to see whether the facilities provided are being implemented on ground. The objective which 'Bonfast Cement Ltd.' is trying to achieve is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Social objective. Bonfast Cement Ltd. is providing housing, schools, safe drinking water, health and hygiene support to 7 villages. These activities benefit the community at large and are aimed at social welfare, which is the hallmark of a social objective. Personal objectives relate to individual employees' needs, organizational objectives relate to the firm's growth and survival, and economic objectives relate to profit generation — none of which are the focus here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) सामाजिक उद्देश्य है। बोनफास्ट सीमेंट लिमिटेड 7 गाँवों को आवास, विद्यालय, सुरक्षित पेयजल, स्वास्थ्य और स्वच्छता की सुविधाएँ प्रदान कर रही है। ये गतिविधियाँ समाज के हित में हैं और सामाजिक कल्याण को दर्शाती हैं, जो सामाजिक उद्देश्य की पहचान है।

questions.text: ______________ का सम्बन्ध उन कार्यों की रूपरेखा तैयार करना है जिसमें विविध प्रकार के कार्य तत्व सम्मिलित हैं, उच्च स्तरीय ज्ञान तथा कौशल की आवश्यकता है, जो कर्मचारियों को अधिक स्वायत्तता देती है तथा व्यक्तिगत विकास के लिए उत्तरदायित्व सौंपती है ताकि वे अर्थपूर्ण कार्य अनुभव प्राप्त कर सकें ।
questions.text_english: _______________ is concerned with designing jobs that include greater variety of work content, require higher level of knowledge and skill, and give workers more autonomy and providing them opportunity for personal growth and a meaningful work experience.

options.C: कर्मचारियों को पहचान देने संबंधित कार्यक्रम

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Job enrichment. Job enrichment is a motivational technique that involves redesigning a job to include greater variety of tasks, higher skill requirements, increased autonomy, and greater personal growth opportunities, thereby making the work more meaningful. Job security refers to employment continuity, perquisites are non-monetary benefits, and employee recognition programmes reward achievements — none describe job redesign as defined in the question.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) पद संवर्धन है। पद संवर्धन एक प्रेरणात्मक तकनीक है जिसमें कार्य को इस प्रकार पुनर्डिज़ाइन किया जाता है कि उसमें कार्य की विविधता, उच्च कौशल की आवश्यकता, अधिक स्वायत्तता और व्यक्तिगत विकास के अवसर शामिल हों।

questions.text:
कार्यबल में महिलाओं की बढ़ती हुई उपस्थिति के कारण 'किसान मार्ट' प्रत्येक शुक्रवार को ऑफिस जाने वाली महिलाओं को सप्ताह के अंत में दैनिक उपयोग की वस्तुओं की खरीददारी के प्रति आकर्षित करने के लिए अत्यधिक छूट वाले प्रस्ताव लाता है ।
उपर्युक्त स्थिति में व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के किस आयाम पर प्रकाश डाला गया है ?
questions.text_english:
Due to increasing presence of women in the workforce, 'Kisan Mart' comes out every Friday with big discount offers on daily use items to attract office-going women to shop on weekends.
Which dimension of business environment is being highlighted in the above case ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Social environment. The increasing presence of women in the workforce is a social change — a shift in the composition and lifestyle of society. Kisan Mart is responding to this social trend by offering weekend discounts for working women. Legal environment refers to laws and regulations, political environment to government policies, and technological environment to changes in technology — none of which are relevant here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) सामाजिक पर्यावरण है। कार्यबल में महिलाओं की बढ़ती भागीदारी एक सामाजिक परिवर्तन है। 'किसान मार्ट' इस सामाजिक प्रवृत्ति का लाभ उठाते हुए कामकाजी महिलाओं के लिए सप्ताहांत में छूट की पेशकश कर रहा है।

questions.text:
'हर्षिता पर्ल्स' जहाँ एक ओर अपने कर्मचारियों को अभिप्रेरित करने के लिए वेतन वृद्धि, पदोन्नति, पहचान आदि से पुरस्कृत करती है, वहीं दूसरी ओर कर्मचारियों को एक वांछित तरीके से कार्य के प्रति प्रेरित करने के लिए वेतन-वृद्धि को रोकना, सज़ा देना, धमकी देने आदि का भी प्रयोग करती है ।
उपर्युक्त स्थिति में अभिप्रेरणा की किस विशेषता पर प्रकाश डाला गया है ?
questions.text_english:
To motivate its employees on one side, 'Harshita Pearls' rewards them with increase in pay, promotion, recognition, etc. whereas on the other side it stops increments, gives punishment, threatens employees so that they may act in a desired manner.
Which feature of motivation is being highlighted in the above case ?

options.C: अभिप्रेरणा या तो सकारात्मक या नकारात्मक हो सकती है ।
options.D: अभिप्रेरणा एक लक्ष्य-आधारित व्यवहार को जन्म देती है ।

options_english.C: Motivation can be either positive or negative.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Motivation can be either positive or negative. Harshita Pearls uses both positive motivators (pay increase, promotion, recognition) and negative motivators (stopping increments, punishment, threats). This dual approach clearly illustrates that motivation can be positive — encouraging desired behaviour through rewards — or negative — compelling desired behaviour through fear of punishment. The other options do not capture this duality shown in the case.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) अभिप्रेरणा या तो सकारात्मक या नकारात्मक हो सकती है। हर्षिता पर्ल्स सकारात्मक प्रेरकों (वेतन वृद्धि, पदोन्नति) और नकारात्मक प्रेरकों (सज़ा, धमकी) दोनों का उपयोग करती है, जो इस विशेषता को स्पष्ट करता है।

questions.text:
'मुद्रो इन्फ्राटैक' को एक बड़ी राशि के लाभ की संभावना के साथ दस माह में दो बड़े घर बनाने का एक लघु-अवधि अनुबन्ध प्राप्त हुआ । कार्य प्रबंधक ने इस चुनौती को स्वीकार किया और दी गई समय अवधि में कार्य पूरा कर दिया । इस अस्थाई आदेश के कारण कंपनी का लाभ 40% बढ़ गया । वित्तीय प्रबंधक इस बात से अवगत था कि निकट भविष्य में कंपनी इतना अधिक लाभ अर्जित नहीं कर सकेगी । अतः उसने निर्णय लिया कि वह प्रति अंश लाभांश में वृद्धि नहीं करेगा क्योंकि कंपनी के इस वर्ष के लाभ में तो वृद्धि हुई है लेकिन कंपनी की आय-अर्जन संभावना में वृद्धि नहीं हुई है । वह यह भी जानता था कि आय में यह वृद्धि अस्थाई प्रकृति की थी ।
उपर्युक्त में लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले जिस घटक पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है :
questions.text_english:
'Mudro Infratech' got a short-term contract for building two villas within a period of ten months with the expectation to earn a huge amount of profit. The Works Manager accepted this challenge and completed the work within the given time period. The profit of the company went up by 40% due to this temporary order. The Finance Manager was aware that the company would not earn this huge profit in the near future. So, he decided not to increase dividend per share as earnings for the year had gone up, but not the earning potential of the company. He also knew that this increase in earnings was temporary in nature.
The factor affecting Dividend Decision being highlighted above is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Stability of dividends. The Finance Manager decided not to increase the dividend per share despite a 40% rise in profit, because the profit increase was temporary and did not reflect a permanent improvement in earning potential. Companies generally try to maintain a stable dividend policy, as investors prefer consistent dividends. Increasing dividends based on a one-time, temporary profit would create an expectation that could not be sustained in future years.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) लाभांश का स्थायित्व है। वित्तीय प्रबंधक ने लाभ में 40% वृद्धि के बावजूद लाभांश नहीं बढ़ाया, क्योंकि यह वृद्धि अस्थाई प्रकृति की थी। कंपनियाँ सामान्यतः स्थिर लाभांश नीति बनाए रखती हैं ताकि निवेशकों का विश्वास बना रहे।

questions.text:
विश्वविद्यालय में अध्ययन करते समय रौनक ने अनुभव किया कि छात्रों को चौबीसों घंटे जलपान उपलब्ध कराने के लिए विश्वविद्यालय परिसर में एक जलपानगृह होना चाहिए । महाविद्यालय से पास होने के पश्चात् उसने विश्वविद्यालय परिसर में 'हंगर पॉइंट' नाम के एक जलपानगृह की स्थापना बर्गर, पिज़्ज़ा, स्ट्रीट फूड तथा और विभिन्न प्रकार के मेन्यू के साथ की । इसके लिए उसने विश्वविद्यालय प्रशासन से आवश्यक अनुमति प्राप्त की । क्योंकि ऐसे पर्यावरण में जहाँ छात्र दिन-रात अध्ययन करते हैं, वह पहला व्यक्ति था जिसने सभी छात्रों के लिए एक जलपानगृह की आवश्यकता को पहचाना, अतिशीघ्र यह एक लोकप्रिय जलपानगृह बन गया । छः माह में 'हंगर पॉइंट' ने अच्छा लाभ अर्जित करना आरम्भ कर दिया ।
उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के महत्त्व के बिन्दु की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Raunaq, while studying at the university, felt that there should be a food joint in the university campus to provide food to students round the clock. After passing out of college, he set up 'Hunger Point', a food joint with a varied menu ranging from burgers, pizzas, street food and much more, in the university campus. For this, he obtained necessary permissions from the university administration. Since he was the first one to recognize the need for a food joint for all the students in an environment where students study day and night, it soon became a popular eating joint. Within six months, 'Hunger Point' started earning good profits.
Identify the point of importance of business environment discussed in the above case :

options.A: यह फ़र्म को अवसरों की पहचान करने एवं पहल करने के योग्य बनाता है ।
options.B: यह फ़र्म को खतरों की पहचान एवं समय से पहले चेतावनी में सहायता करता है ।
options.C: यह नियोजन एवं नीति निर्धारण में सहायता करता है ।
options.D: यह निष्पादन में सुधार में सहायता करता है ।

options_english.A: It enables the firm to identify opportunities and get the first mover advantage.
options_english.B: It helps the firm to identify threats and early warning signals.
options_english.C: It helps in assisting in planning and policy formulation.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) It enables the firm to identify opportunities and get the first mover advantage. Raunaq identified an unmet need in the university environment — the absence of a 24-hour food joint — and was the first to capitalise on this opportunity. This is the classic example of first mover advantage. He did not respond to threats or improve existing performance, nor was this primarily a planning exercise — it was about spotting and seizing an opportunity before anyone else.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। रौनक ने विश्वविद्यालय परिसर में 24 घंटे भोजन की अनपूरित आवश्यकता को पहचाना और सबसे पहले इस अवसर का लाभ उठाया — यह प्रथम प्रस्तावक लाभ का उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है।

questions.text: 'मास्लो का आवश्यकता अनुक्रम सिद्धान्त' कुछ संकल्पनाओं पर आधारित है । इन संकल्पनाओं के सम्बन्ध में ग़लत कथन को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english: 'Maslow's Need Hierarchy theory' is based on certain assumptions. Identify the incorrect statement with respect to these assumptions :

options.A: व्यक्तियों का व्यवहार उनकी आवश्यकताओं पर निर्भर करता है ।
options.B: एक आवश्यकता की संतुष्टि होते ही उस व्यक्ति को वह और प्रेरित नहीं कर सकती है ।
options.C: आधारभूत आवश्यकताओं से प्रारम्भ होकर अन्य उच्च स्तरीय आवश्यकताओं तक लोगों की आवश्यकताएँ एक क्रम शृंखला में होती हैं ।
options.D: एक व्यक्ति केवल तभी निम्न स्तरीय आवश्यकताओं की ओर बढ़ता है जब एक उच्च स्तरीय आवश्यकता की संतुष्टि हो जाती है ।

options_english.A: People's behaviour is based on their needs.
options_english.B: A satisfied need can no longer motivate a person.
options_english.C: People's needs are in a hierarchical order, starting from basic needs to higher level needs.
options_english.D: A person moves to lower level of need only when a higher level need is satisfied.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D), which is the incorrect statement. According to Maslow's Need Hierarchy Theory, a person moves to a higher level of need only when a lower level need is satisfied — not the other way around. Option D reverses this logic by stating that a person moves to a lower level need when a higher level need is satisfied, which contradicts Maslow's theory. Options A, B, and C are all correct assumptions of the theory.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है, जो ग़लत कथन है। मास्लो के सिद्धांत के अनुसार, व्यक्ति तभी उच्च स्तर की आवश्यकता की ओर बढ़ता है जब निम्न स्तर की आवश्यकता पूरी हो जाती है। विकल्प D इसे उलटे तरीके से प्रस्तुत करता है, जो गलत है।

questions.text:
नियति मानसरोवर गार्डन के एक विद्यालय में अध्यापिका के रूप में कार्यरत है । वह विद्यालय में बच्चों को सदैव यह बताती है कि वातावरण को प्रदूषित न करें, एवं चिप्स एवं चॉकलेट के रैपर्स को इधर-उधर न फेंकें । वह सदैव अपने साथ एक थैला रखती है और उसमें रैपर्स को इकट्ठा करती है और उन्हें कूड़ेदान में डाल देती है ।
ऐसा करके वह उपभोक्ता के किस उत्तरदायित्व का निर्वहन कर रही है :
questions.text_english:
Niyati is working as a teacher in a school in Mansarovar Garden. She always tells the children at the school not to pollute the environment, and not to throw wrappers of chips and chocolates here and there. She always carries a bag with her to collect the wrappers and put them in the dustbin.
By doing this, which responsibility of a consumer is she discharging :

options.B: यह सुनिश्चित करना कि एक संतोषजनक सौदा प्राप्त हो

options_english.B: Asserting to get a fair deal

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Respecting the environment. Niyati consciously collects wrappers and puts them in the dustbin instead of littering, and also educates children to do the same. This behaviour directly reflects the consumer responsibility of respecting and protecting the environment. Reading labels is about being an informed consumer, asserting for a fair deal relates to consumer rights, and being honest in dealings is a general ethical responsibility — none of these match the situation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) पर्यावरण का सम्मान करना है। नियति रैपर्स को इकट्ठा करती है और कूड़ेदान में डालती है, जो पर्यावरण संरक्षण के उपभोक्ता उत्तरदायित्व को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: विमुद्रीकरण के सम्बन्ध में ग़लत कथन का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Choose the incorrect statement with respect to demonetization :

options.A: सम्पत्ति खरीदने को छोड़कर वैध मुद्रा के दो सर्वाधिक मूल्यवर्ग, ₹ 500 तथा ₹ 1000 के नोट तत्काल प्रभाव से विमुद्रित कर दिए गए ।
options.B: इसका उद्देश्य भ्रष्टाचार तथा काले धन के संचय को रोकना था ।
options.C: इसके द्वारा कर प्रशासन ने बचतों को सही वित्तीय प्रणाली की तरफ आगे बढ़ाया ।
options.D: घरेलू मुद्रा की परिवर्तनीयता तथा बैंक जमा पर प्रतिबंध लगाए गए ।

options_english.A: The two largest denomination notes of ₹ 500 and ₹ 1000 were demonetized with immediate effect, ceasing to be legal tender except for buying properties.
options_english.B: The aim of this step was to curb corruption and accumulation of black money.
options_english.C: It led to the tax administration channelizing savings into the formal financial system.
options_english.D: Restrictions were placed on the convertibility of domestic money and bank deposits.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A), which is the incorrect statement. During India's 2016 demonetization, the ₹500 and ₹1000 notes ceased to be legal tender with immediate effect for all transactions — there was no special exception made for buying properties. The notes were demonetized completely. Options B, C, and D are all factually correct statements about demonetization.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है, जो गलत कथन है। 2016 के विमुद्रीकरण में ₹500 और ₹1000 के नोट सभी लेनदेन के लिए तत्काल वैध मुद्रा नहीं रहे — संपत्ति खरीद के लिए कोई विशेष छूट नहीं थी।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :

अभिकथन (A) : जब विनियोजन कार्य का निष्पादन सही ढंग से होता है तो दुर्लभ संसाधनों का आबंटन उन फर्मों को होता है जो अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए उच्चतम उत्पादकता रखते हैं ।
कारण (R) : विनियोजन कार्य निधियों को उनके सर्वाधिक उत्पादक निवेश अवसरों में विनियोजित या प्रवर्तित करते हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

Assertion (A) : When the allocative function is performed well, scarce resources are allocated to those firms which have the highest productivity for the economy.
Reason (R) : Allocative function allocates or directs funds into their most productive investment opportunity.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. The allocative function of financial markets works by directing funds to their most productive investment opportunities (Reason). As a result of this, when the function is performed well, scarce resources (capital) get channelled to the most productive firms in the economy (Assertion). The Reason is thus the direct causal explanation for the Assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण, अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या है। विनियोजन कार्य निधियों को सबसे अधिक उत्पादक निवेश अवसरों में निर्देशित करता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप दुर्लभ संसाधन सबसे उत्पादक फर्मों को आवंटित होते हैं।
questions.topic: Functions of Financial Market — Allocative Function

questions.text:
भारत में कानूनी ढाँचे के अनुसार यह आवश्यक है कि निर्माता उत्पाद के लेबल पर उत्पाद के घटक, निर्माण तिथि, मात्रा, मूल्य, उपयोग के लिए दिशा-निर्देश आदि के बारे में सूचना प्रदान करें ।
निम्नलिखित में से उस उपभोक्ता अधिकार की पहचान कीजिए जिसे फ़र्म इस आवश्यकता की पूर्ति से संतुष्ट करती है :
questions.text_english:
The legal framework in India requires the manufacturers to provide information about ingredients, date of manufacture, quantity, price, directions for use, etc., on the label of the product.
From the following, identify the consumer right that is satisfied by the firm by fulfilling the requirement :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Right to be informed. By mandating that manufacturers print information about ingredients, manufacturing date, quantity, price, and directions for use on the product label, the legal framework ensures that consumers have access to complete and accurate information before making a purchase decision. This directly fulfils the Right to be Informed. The Right to Safety protects against hazardous products, Right to be Assured relates to availability of goods, and Right to be Heard relates to consumer complaints — none of which are addressed here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) सूचना का अधिकार है। लेबल पर घटक, निर्माण तिथि, मूल्य आदि की जानकारी देना उपभोक्ताओं को खरीद के पूर्व पूर्ण और सटीक सूचना प्रदान करता है, जो सूचना के अधिकार को संतुष्ट करता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से उस एक की पहचान कीजिए जो शेयर बाज़ार का कार्य नहीं है :
questions.text_english: From the following, identify the one which is not a function of stock exchange :

options.A: विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों को द्रवता एवं विक्रेयता उपलब्ध कराना
options.D: यह सुनिश्चित करना कि यहाँ सट्टेबाज़ी के लिए कोई अवसर उपलब्ध नहीं है

options_english.A: Providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities
options_english.D: Ensuring that there is no scope for speculation

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). Ensuring that there is no scope for speculation is NOT a function of a stock exchange. In fact, stock exchanges provide a platform where some level of speculative trading is inherent. The recognised functions of a stock exchange include providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities (A), spreading the equity culture among investors (B), and ensuring the safety of transactions through regulated procedures (C).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। यह सुनिश्चित करना कि सट्टेबाज़ी के लिए कोई अवसर न हो — यह शेयर बाज़ार का कार्य नहीं है। शेयर बाज़ार के मान्य कार्यों में विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों को द्रवता प्रदान करना, इक्विटी संस्कृति का प्रसार और लेनदेन की सुरक्षा शामिल हैं।

questions.text:
कथन I : नेतृत्व एक व्यक्ति की उस योग्यता की ओर संकेत करता है जिससे वह अन्य व्यक्तियों के व्यवहार को प्रभावित करता है ।
कथन II : नेतृत्व का प्रयोग नेता द्वारा व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति के लिए किया जाता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement I : Leadership indicates the ability of an individual which influences the behaviour of others.
Statement II : Leadership is exercised to achieve personal goals of the leader.
Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Statement I is true — leadership is indeed the ability of an individual to influence the behaviour of others toward the achievement of organisational goals. Statement II is false — leadership is not exercised for the personal goals of the leader; rather, it is exercised to guide followers toward achieving organisational or group objectives. A leader who uses authority purely for personal gain is not exercising effective leadership.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। कथन I सत्य है — नेतृत्व एक व्यक्ति की वह योग्यता है जो दूसरों के व्यवहार को प्रभावित करती है। कथन II असत्य है — नेतृत्व व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्यों के लिए नहीं बल्कि संगठनात्मक उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति के लिए किया जाता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से पहचानिए कि दिए गए चित्र में क्या दर्शाया गया है :
questions.text_english: Identify from the following what is depicted in the given picture :

options.D: ब्राण्ड नाम तथा ब्राण्ड मार्क दोनों

options_english.D: Both Brand Name and Brand Mark

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Both Brand Name and Brand Mark. The image shows the text 'Amar Sweets' which is the Brand Name — the part of the brand that can be spoken or written. It also shows a stylised symbol/logo (the letter 'A' in a distinctive design) which is the Brand Mark — the part of the brand that can be recognised but not spoken. Since both elements are present, the correct answer is (D). A Trade Mark is a brand that has been given legal protection, which is not depicted here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) ब्राण्ड नाम तथा ब्राण्ड मार्क दोनों है। चित्र में 'Amar Sweets' ब्राण्ड नाम है (जिसे पढ़ा और बोला जा सकता है) और एक विशिष्ट 'A' चिह्न ब्राण्ड मार्क है (जिसे पहचाना जा सकता है लेकिन बोला नहीं जा सकता)।
questions.topic: Branding — Brand Name and Brand Mark

questions.text: ____________ में प्रतिभूतियों का एक खाता खोला जा सकता है, सभी अंशों को इसमें जमा कराया जा सकता है । किसी भी समय इन्हें निकाला/बेचा जा सकता है तथा निवेशक की ओर से अंशों के वितरण अथवा उन्हें प्राप्त करने सम्बन्धी सूचना दी जा सकती है ।
questions.text_english: In the ____________ a securities account can be opened, all shares can be deposited in it. These can be withdrawn / sold at any time and instruction to deliver or receive shares on behalf of the investor can be given.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Depository. A depository is an institution that holds securities (such as shares, debentures, bonds) in electronic or dematerialised form on behalf of investors. Investors can open a demat (securities) account with a depository participant, deposit their shares, and give instructions for delivery or receipt of shares at any time. In India, NSDL and CDSL are the two depositories. A primary market deals with new issue of securities, a stock exchange provides a trading platform, and a bank handles monetary deposits — none of them hold securities in a demat account format.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) निक्षेपागार है। निक्षेपागार एक संस्था है जो निवेशकों की प्रतिभूतियों को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में रखती है। भारत में NSDL और CDSL दो प्रमुख निक्षेपागार हैं।

questions.text:
कथन I : वित्तीय प्रबंध का उद्देश्य अंशधारियों की धन-सम्पदा में अधिकतम वृद्धि करना है ।
कथन II : यदि बाज़ार में अंशों का मूल्य बढ़ता है, तो अंशधारियों को लाभ होता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement I : The objective of financial management is to maximize shareholders' wealth.
Statement II : The shareholders gain if the value of shares in the market increases.
Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both the Statements are true. Statement I is correct — the primary objective of financial management is the maximisation of shareholders' wealth, which means maximising the market value of equity shares. Statement II is also correct — shareholders gain when the market price of their shares increases, because they can sell at a higher price or their investment value grows. Both statements are therefore factually accurate and consistent with financial management theory.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है — दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। वित्तीय प्रबंध का उद्देश्य अंशधारियों की सम्पदा को अधिकतम करना है, और यह तब होता है जब बाज़ार में अंशों का मूल्य बढ़ता है।

questions.text:
अधिकांश संगठनों ने आजकल अपने-आप को बदलते हुए पर्यावरण के अनुरूप अनुकूलित कर लिया है । अपने लक्षित उपभोक्ताओं तक पहुँचने तथा उनके साथ जुड़े रहने के लिए उन्होंने सोशल मीडिया जैसे फेसबुक, इंस्टाग्राम आदि पर अपनी मजबूत उपस्थिति आरम्भ कर दी है ।
निम्नलिखित में से प्रबन्ध की जिस विशेषता पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, उसे पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
Most of the organizations these days have adapted themselves to changing environment. To reach and engage with the target customers, they started to have a strong presence on social media like Facebook, Instagram, etc.
From the following, identify the feature of management being highlighted :

options.B: प्रबन्ध एक निरन्तर चलने वाली प्रक्रिया है ।

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Management is a dynamic function. The case shows that organisations have adapted themselves to a changing external environment by adopting social media platforms to reach customers. This ability to change strategies and practices in response to environmental shifts is the defining feature of management as a dynamic function. It is not merely a group activity, a continuous process, or multidimensional in this context — the emphasis is specifically on adaptability and responsiveness to change.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) प्रबन्ध एक गतिशील कार्य है। संगठनों ने बदलते पर्यावरण के अनुरूप सोशल मीडिया अपनाया — यह प्रबंध की गतिशीलता को दर्शाता है जो परिवर्तनों के साथ अनुकूलित होने की क्षमता है।

questions.text:
कॉलम I में दिए गए प्रबन्ध के स्तरों का कॉलम II में दिए गए प्रत्येक स्तर पर निष्पादित किए जाने वाले कार्यों से मिलान कीजिए :

कॉलम I — कॉलम II
1. उच्च स्तरीय प्रबंध — (i) ये कार्यबल के प्रयासों की प्रत्यक्ष देखरेख करते हैं ।
2. मध्य स्तरीय प्रबंध — (ii) ये यह सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि इनके विभाग में पर्याप्त संख्या में कर्मचारी हैं ।
3. प्रचालन प्रबंध — (iii) ये संगठन के कल्याण एवं निरंतरता के लिए उत्तरदायी होते हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Match the Levels of Management given in Column I with the functions performed at each level given in Column II :

Column I — Column II
1. Top Level Management — (i) They directly oversee the efforts of the workforce.
2. Middle Level Management — (ii) They ensure that their department has the necessary personnel.
3. Operational Management — (iii) They are responsible for the welfare and survival of the organisation.

Choose the correct option from the following :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B): 1-(iii), 2-(ii), 3-(i). Top Level Management (e.g., Board of Directors, CEO) is responsible for the overall welfare and long-term survival of the organisation — matching (iii). Middle Level Management (e.g., Departmental Heads) ensures that their departments are adequately staffed with the necessary personnel — matching (ii). Operational/Supervisory Management directly oversees the day-to-day efforts of the workforce on the shop floor — matching (i).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B): 1-(iii), 2-(ii), 3-(i) है। उच्च स्तरीय प्रबंध संगठन के कल्याण और निरंतरता के लिए उत्तरदायी है। मध्य स्तरीय प्रबंध विभाग में पर्याप्त कर्मचारियों की सुनिश्चितता करता है। प्रचालन प्रबंध कार्यबल की प्रत्यक्ष देखरेख करता है।

questions.text:
'पनमोल डेयरी' ने घी बनाने की पर्यावरण-हितैषी 'बिलोना' विधि का प्रयोग आरम्भ किया है, जबकि अन्य डेयरियाँ मशीनों एवं रसायनों को सम्मिलित कर आधुनिक विधियों का उपयोग कर रही हैं । ऐसा करके 'पनमोल डेयरी' ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के सैकड़ों अनपढ़ लोगों को रोज़गार प्रदान कर रही है ।
'पनमोल डेयरी' प्रबन्ध के किस उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करना चाह रही है :
questions.text_english:
'Panmol Dairy' started using environment-friendly 'Bilona' method of making ghee, unlike other dairies which were using modern methods involving machines and chemicals. By doing this, 'Panmol Dairy' is providing employment to hundreds of illiterate people in the rural areas.
Which objective of management is 'Panmol Dairy' trying to achieve :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Social objective. Panmol Dairy is using an eco-friendly traditional method (Bilona) and employing hundreds of illiterate rural people who might otherwise be unemployed. Both actions — protecting the environment and providing employment to the marginalised — are social contributions that benefit the community. This clearly reflects the social objective of management. National objectives are broader policy-level goals, personal objectives relate to individual employees, and economic objectives focus on profit and survival — none capture the community-welfare angle shown here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) सामाजिक उद्देश्य है। पनमोल डेयरी पर्यावरण-हितैषी विधि अपना रही है और ग्रामीण अनपढ़ लोगों को रोज़गार दे रही है — दोनों ही सामाजिक कल्याण के कार्य हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन वित्तीय नियोजन के महत्त्व पर प्रकाश नहीं डाल रहा है :
questions.text_english: Which of the following statements is not highlighting the importance of financial planning :

options.A: यह विभिन्न व्यावसायिक परिस्थितियों में क्या घटित हो सकता है का पूर्वानुमान लगाने में सहायता करता है ।
options.B: यह व्यावसायिक आकस्मिक परेशानियों तथा विस्मयों से बचने में सहायता करता है तथा कंपनी के भविष्य निर्माण में भी सहायक होता है ।
options.C: यह अनवरत आधार पर निवेश तथा वित्तीय निर्णयों में सम्पर्क स्थापित करता है ।
options.D: वित्तीय नियोजन में कार्य की विस्तृत योजना तैयार करके अपव्यय, क्रियाओं की पुनरावृत्ति तथा नियोजन के अंतराल में वृद्धि होती है ।

sub_questions.text_english: Explain any three psychological barriers to communication.

key_points: Premature evaluation — judging the message before it is fully received
Lack of attention — receiver's mind is preoccupied with other concerns
Loss by transmission and poor retention — information gets distorted as it passes through multiple levels

sub_questions.solution: Three psychological barriers to communication are: (1) Premature Evaluation — When the receiver judges the value of a message before it is fully transmitted, important information may be ignored. This happens when listeners assume they already know what the sender will say. (2) Lack of Attention — When the receiver's mind is preoccupied with other thoughts or concerns, they fail to listen carefully to the message, causing a communication breakdown. (3) Loss by Transmission and Poor Retention — As a message passes through multiple levels in an organisation, it tends to get filtered, distorted, or partially lost. People also tend to retain only a fraction of what they receive, so the original message may not be accurately communicated.

Facilitates change — helps the organisation adapt to changes by guiding people through them

sub_questions.text_english: Give the meaning of 'Contract Note' and 'T+2' system in the trading procedure in a stock exchange.

key_points: Contract Note is a document confirming the details of a trade executed on behalf of the investor
T+2 means settlement of trade occurs within 2 working days of the transaction date

sub_questions.solution:
Contract Note: A contract note is a legally binding document issued by a stockbroker to a client after executing a trade on their behalf. It contains details such as the name and quantity of securities traded, the price, the date and time of the transaction, and the brokerage charged. It serves as evidence of the transaction.

T+2 System: 'T' stands for the transaction date — the day on which a buy or sell order is executed on the stock exchange. Under the T+2 settlement system, the actual settlement of the transaction (i.e., the delivery of securities and payment of money) is completed within two working days of the transaction date. This system ensures timely and efficient settlement of trades.

key_points: Registration of brokers, sub-brokers, and other market intermediaries
Regulation of the business in stock exchanges and other securities markets
Prohibition of insider trading and fraudulent and unfair trade practices

sub_questions.solution: Three regulatory functions of SEBI are: (1) Registration of Intermediaries — SEBI registers and regulates all market intermediaries such as stockbrokers, sub-brokers, merchant bankers, portfolio managers, and investment advisers to ensure that only qualified and honest participants operate in the market. (2) Regulation of Stock Exchange Business — SEBI regulates the business conducted in stock exchanges and other securities markets to ensure fair, transparent, and orderly trading activity. (3) Prohibition of Insider Trading and Fraudulent Practices — SEBI prohibits trading on the basis of unpublished price-sensitive information (insider trading) and takes strict action against fraudulent and unfair trade practices to protect investors and maintain market integrity.

questions.text_english: Vibhas recently joined as a Human Resource Manager of 'Bajanta Enterprises'. The company had embarked on a special project for which Vibhas had appointed twenty new employees. After the employees underwent on-the-job training for a month and had been on the job for some time, there was a need to evaluate their performance against certain pre-determined standards. Career Planning and Development — designing activities for employees' long-term career growth and promotion

Performance appraisal helps management make decisions about promotions, salary revisions, transfers, and training needs. It also gives employees feedback on their strengths and areas for improvement.

key_points: Planning leads to rigidity
Planning may not work in a dynamic environment
Planning reduces creativity
Planning involves huge costs

sub_questions.solution: Four limitations of Planning are: (1) Planning Leads to Rigidity — Once a plan is formulated, managers may feel bound to follow it even when circumstances change. This rigidity can prevent the organisation from adapting to new developments and can reduce responsiveness. (2) Planning May Not Work in a Dynamic Environment — The business environment is constantly changing due to technology, market shifts, competition, and government policies. In such a volatile environment, plans may become outdated very quickly, making it difficult to rely on them. (3) Planning Reduces Creativity — When a single plan is set and all efforts are directed toward it, employees may stop thinking creatively and instead simply follow instructions. Middle and lower management may stop using their initiative because they are expected to execute rather than innovate. (4) Planning Involves Huge Costs — The planning process is time-consuming and expensive. Collecting information, forecasting the future, and evaluating alternatives requires significant financial and human resources. Sometimes the cost of planning exceeds its benefits.

Clarity in working relationships
Optimum utilisation of resources
Adaptation to change

sub_questions.solution: Four points of importance of Organising are: (1) Benefits of Specialisation — Organising divides the total work into specific tasks and assigns them to individuals who specialise in those areas. This leads to greater efficiency, higher quality output, and faster task completion due to specialisation and division of labour. (2) Clarity in Working Relationships — Organising clearly defines the authority and responsibility of each employee and establishes proper superior-subordinate relationships. This clarity prevents conflicts, reduces duplication of effort, and ensures accountability. (3) Optimum Utilisation of Resources — A well-organised structure ensures that all physical, financial, and human resources are allocated appropriately, minimising waste and ensuring maximum productivity from available inputs. (4) Adaptation to Change — A properly designed organisational structure makes it easier for the organisation to adapt to changes in the business environment by reallocating tasks, responsibilities, and authority as needed without disrupting overall functioning.

key_points: Educating consumers about their rights and responsibilities
Filing cases in consumer courts on behalf of consumers
Testing products for quality and publishing the results
Organising campaigns and demonstrations to promote consumer awareness

questions.solution: Four functions performed by consumer organisations and NGOs for protecting and promoting the interests of consumers are: (1) Consumer Education — These organisations educate consumers about their legal rights, responsibilities, and the remedies available to them under the Consumer Protection Act. They publish pamphlets, hold workshops, and use media to spread awareness. (2) Filing Complaints and Legal Support — Consumer organisations file complaints on behalf of aggrieved consumers in consumer forums and courts, and provide legal assistance to consumers who have been exploited or received defective goods or deficient services. (3) Product Testing and Publishing Results — They conduct independent tests on goods available in the market, check their quality and safety, and publish the findings. This helps consumers make informed choices and also pressures manufacturers to maintain quality standards. (4) Lobbying and Advocacy — Consumer organisations lobby with the government for stronger consumer protection laws, better enforcement, and policy changes that benefit consumers. They also conduct awareness campaigns and demonstrations to highlight malpractices in the market.

उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित दो प्रकार की योजनाओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए ।
questions.text_english:
'Leno' is a reputed car manufacturing company, which is going to complete its 75 years in October 2024. The Chief Executive Officer of the company decided to take the company to a higher level. For this he called a meeting of all departmental heads of the company. In the meeting, the Chief Executive Officer proposed a target to increase sales by 10% and profits by 20% in its Platinum Jubilee year.
The Human Resource Manager estimated that an increase of 500 workers would be required to achieve the target. The Finance Manager suggested that the company must hold adequate cash balances for various purposes, and he will prepare a statement showing the estimated cash inflows and outflows for this particular period.
Identify and explain two types of plans discussed in the above case.

key_points: Objective — the target to increase sales by 10% and profits by 20% in the Platinum Jubilee year
Budget — the statement prepared by the Finance Manager showing estimated cash inflows and outflows

questions.solution:
The two types of plans discussed in the above case are:

1. Objective: An objective is a specific, measurable result that an organisation aims to achieve within a defined time period. In the case, the CEO proposed the objective of increasing sales by 10% and profits by 20% in the Platinum Jubilee year. Objectives provide direction and serve as benchmarks against which actual performance can be measured. They form the foundation of all planning activities.

2. Budget: A budget is a statement that expresses future plans in numerical or financial terms for a specific period. The Finance Manager proposed to prepare a statement showing the estimated cash inflows and outflows for the period. This is a Cash Budget — a type of budget that helps the organisation plan and manage its liquidity by estimating how much cash will come in and go out during a given period. Budgets serve as tools for both planning and control.
questions.topic: Types of Plans — Objectives and Budget

sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Time study
(ii) Method study
(iii) Differential piece wage system

key_points: Time study determines the standard time for a task
Method study finds the best way to perform a task
Differential piece wage system rewards efficient workers with higher rates

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Time Study: Time study is a technique used to determine the standard time required for a trained worker to perform a specific job under normal working conditions. The analyst observes and records the time taken for each element of the task using a stopwatch. This standard time is then used to set production targets, estimate labour costs, and design an equitable wage system. The objective is to eliminate unnecessary delays and establish a fair and realistic standard for performance.

(ii) Method Study: Method study involves finding the best and most efficient way to perform a job. Every activity from receiving raw materials to dispatching the finished goods is analysed to identify and eliminate unnecessary steps, reduce time and effort, and improve workflow. The aim is to minimise the cost of production, reduce fatigue, and increase productivity by standardising the most efficient method of doing work.

(iii) Differential Piece Wage System: This system was developed by F.W. Taylor to motivate workers and distinguish between efficient and inefficient workers. Under this system, two different piece rates are set — a higher rate for workers who meet or exceed the standard output, and a lower rate for workers who produce below the standard. This creates a strong incentive for workers to achieve the standard and rewards high performers proportionately more, thereby encouraging efficiency and productivity.

sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Universal applicability
(ii) Formed by practice and experimentation
(iii) Flexible

key_points: Universal applicability — principles apply to all types and sizes of organisations
Formed by practice and experimentation — developed through observation and research
Flexible — can be adapted and modified to suit different situations

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Universal Applicability: Principles of management are universally applicable — they are not restricted to any one type, size, or sector of organisation. Whether it is a manufacturing firm, a service company, a government body, or a non-profit organisation, and whether it is small or large, domestic or multinational, the principles of management can be applied. However, the degree and manner of application may vary according to the specific situation.

(ii) Formed by Practice and Experimentation: Management principles are not based purely on theory. They are derived from the practical experience of managers observed over long periods and validated through systematic observation, experimentation, and research. Management thinkers like F.W. Taylor and Henri Fayol developed their principles after years of practical experience in industry. This empirical basis makes the principles more reliable and practically useful.

(iii) Flexible: Unlike the absolute laws of natural science, management principles are not rigid rules. They can be modified, adapted, and even abandoned when the situation demands. Managers apply them with discretion, adjusting them to suit the specific circumstances of their organisation, the nature of the task, and the people involved. This flexibility makes them more practical and useful across diverse managerial situations.

(i) Choice of technique
(ii) Financing alternatives
(iii) Growth prospects

OR

(b) Explain the following factors affecting choice of capital structure of a company :
(i) Cost of equity
(ii) Control

(i) Choice of technique
(ii) Financing alternatives
(iii) Growth prospects

key_points: Capital-intensive technique requires more fixed capital; labour-intensive requires less
Leasing reduces fixed capital requirement compared to outright purchase
Higher growth prospects mean higher requirement of fixed capital

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Choice of Technique: The nature of the production technique directly impacts fixed capital requirements. Companies that adopt capital-intensive techniques — relying heavily on machinery, equipment, and technology — require significantly more fixed capital investment. In contrast, companies using labour-intensive techniques, which rely more on human effort than machinery, require less fixed capital. For example, a fully automated factory needs much more investment in plant and machinery than a handicraft unit.

(ii) Financing Alternatives: A company may have the option of acquiring fixed assets either by purchasing them outright or by leasing or renting them. If assets are purchased, the requirement of fixed capital is high. If assets are acquired through operating leases or financial leases, the immediate fixed capital requirement is reduced, as payments are spread over time. Thus, the availability and choice of financing alternatives significantly affect the fixed capital needs of a company.

(iii) Growth Prospects: Companies that expect high levels of future growth will need to invest in additional capacity — more land, plant, machinery, and equipment — to support that anticipated expansion. Such companies require more fixed capital. Companies with modest growth expectations, on the other hand, may not need to expand their infrastructure and thus require less fixed capital.

sub_questions.text:

(ii) नियंत्रण
(iii) शेयर बाज़ार की दशाएँ
sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Cost of equity
(ii) Control
(iii) Stock market conditions

key_points: Higher cost of equity encourages use of debt; lower cost of equity favours equity financing
To retain control, existing shareholders may prefer debt over issuing new equity shares
Buoyant market favours equity issue; depressed market favours debt

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Cost of Equity: The cost of equity refers to the return expected by equity shareholders on their investment. If the cost of equity (dividend + capital appreciation expectation) is high, the company may prefer to raise funds through debt (loans or debentures) as debt interest is a fixed and tax-deductible charge that may be cheaper overall. If the cost of equity is low, the company may prefer equity financing as it does not create a fixed financial obligation.

(ii) Control: The existing shareholders, especially in closely-held companies, may be unwilling to dilute their ownership and voting control by issuing new equity shares. In such cases, the company will prefer to raise funds through debt (debentures, loans) rather than equity, since debt holders do not carry voting rights. Desire to retain control is thus an important factor favouring a higher debt component in the capital structure.

(iii) Stock Market Conditions: The state of the capital market significantly influences the choice of capital structure. During a bullish (buoyant) market, investors have confidence and are willing to invest in equity shares. The company can raise equity capital easily and at favourable terms. During a bearish (depressed) market, investor sentiment is low, equity shares are difficult to sell, and companies prefer to raise funds through debt instruments such as debentures or bonds.

questions.text_english:
'Rewton Ltd.' was a reputed computer software company providing unique software all over India. The turnover of the company was very high resulting in good profits. The Chief Executive Officer, Vihaan, was very strict and disciplined. He specified the boundaries of authority and responsibility for achieving organizational goals. There was systematic coordination among the various activities and specific relationships among various job positions. The company provided facilities like a canteen, a gym, a library, a music room, and a rest area for its employees, which they could use during rest intervals. Using these facilities, the employees developed friendships and discussed not only their personal, social and emotional issues, but also the official ones.
The General Manager was of a different view. He told the Chief Executive Officer that there was no use providing these facilities to the employees as it is an extra financial burden on the organization on one hand and on the other hand, it encourages groupism and whenever any change is required in the organization, they all resist. He suggested that they should do away with these facilities. But the Chief Executive Officer, Vihaan, explained to the General Manager that this type of social interaction is necessary, and is in the best interest of the organization. These interactions among people at work give rise to a network of social relationships among employees and have many benefits.
(i) Identify and explain the type of organisation whose existence the Chief Executive Officer felt was necessary.
(ii) State any two advantages and two disadvantages of the type of organization identified in (i) above.

sub_questions.text: उस संगठन के प्रकार की पहचान कीजिए तथा समझाइए जिसकी उपस्थिति मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने आवश्यक अनुभव की ।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain the type of organisation whose existence the Chief Executive Officer felt was necessary.

key_points: Informal Organisation
Arises spontaneously from social interactions among employees
Not deliberately created by management; based on personal relationships, common interests

sub_questions.solution: The type of organisation whose existence the CEO Vihaan felt was necessary is Informal Organisation. An informal organisation arises spontaneously and naturally from the social interactions and personal relationships among employees working together. It is not deliberately created by management; rather, it emerges when people with shared interests, common working environments, or similar backgrounds begin to form relationships and groups. In the case, the canteen, gym, library, and rest area provided by Rewton Ltd. served as spaces where employees naturally developed friendships and discussed both personal and official matters, giving rise to an informal network of social relationships. The CEO rightly felt that such interaction is in the best interest of the organisation.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त (i) में पहचाने गए संगठन के प्रकार के किन्हीं दो लाभों तथा दो हानियों का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two advantages and two disadvantages of the type of organization identified in (i) above.

key_points: Advantage 1: Provides social satisfaction and fulfils social needs of employees
Advantage 2: Acts as a faster channel of communication (grapevine)
Disadvantage 1: Encourages groupism and resistance to change
Disadvantage 2: Spread of rumours can harm organisational morale

sub_questions.solution:
Two Advantages of Informal Organisation: (1) Fulfils Social Needs — Informal organisation provides employees with a sense of belonging and fulfils their social and emotional needs. Friendships formed at work improve morale, job satisfaction, and motivation, which ultimately benefits the organisation. (2) Faster Communication — The informal network (grapevine) often communicates information more quickly than formal channels. This can supplement formal communication and help management understand employee sentiment and concerns.

Two Disadvantages of Informal Organisation: (1) Encourages Groupism and Resistance to Change — As the General Manager pointed out, informal groups can develop a collective identity that resists organisational changes. When employees become too closely knit in their informal group, they may collectively oppose new policies, restructuring, or changes in work procedures. (2) Spread of Rumours — Informal communication is largely unverified and uncontrolled. False or distorted information (rumours) can spread rapidly through the grapevine, creating confusion, anxiety, and conflict among employees, which can harm organisational functioning.

Nishtha runs a chain of famous restaurants, 'Indian Kitchen', in different parts of Delhi. The restaurant chain was known for good quality food and quick service. 'Indian Kitchen' was generating good revenue and had goodwill in the market. Nishtha would take a weekly report from all the Restaurant Managers and take necessary action to resolve the problems, if any. Nishtha noticed a sudden decline in sales in one of the restaurants. She questioned the Restaurant Manager who mentioned that the restaurant is seeing a gradual decrease in the number of customers, but could not provide a clear explanation for it. So, Nishtha formed a team to find out the causes of the declining customers as this is the key area for restaurant business and is critical to the success of business. By doing this, Nishtha is performing a step of the process of a function of management.
(i) Identify and explain the function of management discussed above.
(ii) Explain the step of the function identified in (i) above, followed by Nishtha to find out the causes of declining revenue.
(iii) Explain the step Nishtha will take after she gets the report from the team formed to find out the causes of declining revenue.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त में चर्चित प्रबन्ध के कार्य की पहचान कीजिए तथा इसे समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain the function of management discussed above.

key_points: Controlling
Ensures actual performance conforms to planned performance
Involves measuring, comparing, and taking corrective action

sub_questions.solution: The function of management discussed is Controlling. Controlling is the process of measuring actual performance, comparing it against the pre-determined standards or plans, and taking corrective action whenever deviations are found. Nishtha regularly collects weekly reports from restaurant managers and takes action to resolve problems — this is the controlling process. When she noticed a decline in sales, she investigated the causes, which is a step in the controlling function. Controlling ensures that the organisation stays on track toward its goals.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त (i) में पहचाने गए कार्य के चरण को समझाइए जिसका निष्ठा ने आगम में कमी के कारणों का पता लगाने के लिए पालन किया ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the step of the function identified in (i) above, followed by Nishtha to find out the causes of declining revenue.

key_points: Analysing Deviations — finding the causes behind the shortfall in revenue

sub_questions.solution: The step followed by Nishtha is Analysing Deviations. In the controlling process, once a deviation is identified — in this case, the unexpected and unexplained decline in customers and revenue at one restaurant — the manager must investigate and analyse the root causes of that deviation. Since the Restaurant Manager could not provide a clear explanation, Nishtha formed a dedicated team to investigate the causes. This step involves digging deeper to understand whether the problem is due to service quality, pricing, competition, location, menu changes, or other factors, so that appropriate corrective action can be taken.

sub_questions.text: आगम में कमी के कारणों का पता लगाने वाली टीम से रिपोर्ट प्राप्त करने के पश्चात् निष्ठा द्वारा लिए जाने वाला अगला चरण समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the step Nishtha will take after she gets the report from the team formed to find out the causes of declining revenue.

key_points: Taking Corrective Action — implementing measures to eliminate the causes of deviation and bring performance back on track

sub_questions.solution: After receiving the report from the investigation team, the next step Nishtha will take is Taking Corrective Action. Once the causes of the revenue decline are identified — for example, poor service quality, menu issues, competitor activity, or operational inefficiencies — Nishtha will implement suitable corrective measures to address the root causes. Corrective action may include retraining staff, revising the menu, improving ambiance, launching promotional offers, or resolving any operational bottlenecks. The objective of this step is to ensure that actual performance aligns with the planned standards and that similar deviations do not recur in the future.
